description: Exact arithmetic and unit work with every number supplied in the prompt.

tasks.title: Invoice total with tax
tasks.prompt: A shop sells 12 notebooks at $8.50 each and 5 binders at $14.20 each. Sales tax is 8% of the subtotal. What is the subtotal, the tax, and the grand total? Show the three numbers.
tasks.rubric: Subtotal 173.00, tax 13.84, total 186.84. Score on all three being correct.

tasks.title: Percentage change
tasks.prompt: A subscription plan cost $80 per month last year and costs $92 per month now. By what percentage did the price increase? Give a single percentage.
tasks.rubric: The increase is 12 on a base of 80, which is 15 percent.

tasks.title: Average of five scores
tasks.prompt: Five quiz scores are 72, 85, 91, 64 and 88. What is the mean score?

tasks.title: Unit conversion
tasks.prompt: Convert 3.5 kilometres to metres and 2.25 hours to minutes. Give both results.

tasks.title: Compound growth
tasks.prompt: A deposit of $1,000 earns 5% interest per year, compounded once per year. What is the balance after 3 years, rounded to the nearest cent?

tasks.title: Combined work rate
tasks.prompt: One packing machine fills 40 boxes per hour and a second fills 25 boxes per hour. Working together at those constant rates, how many hours do they need to fill 390 boxes?

tasks.title: Stacked discounts
tasks.prompt: An item is listed at $250. A 20% discount is applied first, then an extra 10% is taken off the discounted price. What is the final price? Note that this is not the same as a flat 30% off.
tasks.rubric: Correct is 250 * 0.8 * 0.9 = 180. Score zero if the answer is 175.

tasks.title: Clock arithmetic
tasks.prompt: A workshop starts at 9:45 and runs for 2 hours 50 minutes. At what time does it end? Use a 24-hour clock.
